question: On which of the following rivers is the Dantiwada Dam built?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Banas river__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Dantiwada Dam** has been built on the** Banas River in Gujarat.**
 
• The dam was** constructed **to **control floods** and **provide water for irrigation**.
